name: hrrr-native-smoke
description: HRRR-Smoke's own 3-D smoke (wrfnat MASSDEN on its 50 hybrid levels, with the pressure and temperature of the same levels), carried into the domain as the start state and the edge values: HRRR starts each run from its previous run's smoke and takes smoke from RAP at its own edges, so a WOOF run started from HRRR begins with the smoke already in the air.

grid.earth_radius_provenance: GRIB2 shape of the earth 6 (6,371,229 m sphere) in every HRRR record; the same constant gpuwm.ingest.hrrr.HRRR_EARTH_RADIUS_M scales the native route's spacing onto WPS's sphere. spacing_deg only rounds the request area.

vertical.remap_note: HRRR's hybrid levels carry their own pressure (PRES on level type 105), so no A/B coefficients are needed: the source pressure is that field, the lowest level sits in the surface slot at the surface pressure, and the column goes onto the frame's total hydrostatic half-level pressure, as for CAMS.

acquisition.horizon_provenance: Operational HRRR-Smoke v4, since 2020-12-02: https://rapidrefresh.noaa.gov/hrrr/HRRRsmoke/; the 00/06/12/18 UTC forecasts extend to 48 hours. Other hourly cycles stop at 18 hours.
acquisition.latency_note: planning allowance for an hourly HRRR cycle's wrfnat files to be posted, not a measured guarantee

conversion_parameters.provenance: UPP 1296eebb295251d0fe1cc697f47058c62d887977 MDLFLD.f:2442; params.F:57; no humidity factor

units_epochs.provenance: NOAA HRRR wrfnat f00 MASSDEN (0/20/0, level 105, same kg m-3 label) read by .idx byte range: hrrr.20211221 t13z hybrid level 1 median 9.2e-03, max 2.6e+01 (ug m-3); t14z median 9.6e-12, max 2.3e-08 (kg m-3). RAP awp130bgrb switches at the same cycle.

attribution: NOAA HRRR-Smoke, NOAA Open Data Dissemination
provenance: https://registry.opendata.aws/noaa-hrrr-pds/; wrfnat MASSDEN, PRES and TMP on the 50 hybrid levels (level type 105) and PRES at the surface, byte ranges named by each file's .idx inventory. HRRRv4 cycles its smoke from the previous run's 1 h forecast and takes boundary smoke from RAP (Dowell et al. 2022, Wea. Forecasting 37, sections 2d and 3g). Inverse density follows NOAA-EMC/UPP 1296eebb295251d0fe1cc697f47058c62d887977 sorc/ncep_post.fd/MDLFLD.f:2442 and params.F:57.
